info.title: Opero API
info.description: Use the Opero API to connect systems with selected Opero resources. Authenticate requests with an Opero API token.

api-token.description: Opero API token. Send it as Authorization: Bearer ek_...

created.description: True when this apply created the object, false when it only updated an existing one.

partiallyApplied.description: Present and true when the apply committed schema changes before failing. The named objects and fields are live and cannot be rolled back.

failedPhase.description: The apply phase that failed, in execution order.

committedObjects.description: Objects written before the failure. Already live.

requestId.description: Correlation id for the server-side log entry. Set by the MCP server; on the internal API read the X-Request-Id response header instead.

needsRepair.description: Present and true when a schema draft is partially applied and blocked until reconciled.

nextStep.description: How to recover from this error, naming the call to make next. Carried on the error so callers do not have to consult documentation to find the exit.

meta.description: Domain-specific conflict metadata. View Layout conflicts expose the current draft and, when applicable, published version ids. A partially applied schema draft (code: schema_partially_applied) exposes what was committed before the failure.

fieldErrors.description: Per-field validation errors. Present only on VALIDATION_FAILED responses.

unavailableMutationScopes.description: Mutation scopes rejected because the corresponding View Layout block is not available in the current runtime contract.

clientMutationId.description: Client mutation id echoed on complex mutation errors when supplied.

relationTableErrors.description: Structured relation-table validation errors keyed by table field and row id/client id.

idempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency conflict metadata. Present when a clientMutationId cannot be replayed safely.

errors.description: Structured error list. Present on responses with multiple validation errors (e.g. SQL validation).

impacts.description: Structured impact payload. Present on confirm-gated mutations that were refused because they would destroy data — each entry describes one affected record and why.

validation.description: Structured validation payload. Present on validation conflicts that include domain-specific validation state and errors.

value.description: Value stored on the entry metadata when this option is chosen.

label.description: Display-only label for the selector. Null renders the value verbatim.

key.description: Metadata key persisted on every dictionary entry.

type.description: Scalar value type accepted for this metadata key.

required.description: When true, dictionary entry create/save requires a non-null metadata value for this key.

options.description: When present, the field is a closed enumeration: the entry editor renders a selector over these options and writes must use one of their values. STRING fields only.

entryMetadataSchema.description: Dictionary-level metadata schema applied to entry metadata. Empty means arbitrary scalar metadata is accepted.

total.description: Exact total item count. Present for count=exact and may be omitted for count=none or count=hasMore.

hasMore.description: Whether another page exists. Present for endpoints that implement count=hasMore.

metadata.description: Dictionary entry metadata as simple key-value pairs.

color.description: Chip colour for this option as uppercase #RRGGBB, or null when unset.

icon.description: Icon token for this option, or null when unset. Opaque to the backend.

entryMetadataSchema.description: Dictionary-level metadata schema applied to entry metadata. Empty means arbitrary scalar metadata is accepted.

required.description: True when the attribute must be present. Everything else may be omitted.

enum.description: Closed value set. Present for enum-valued attributes such as image.align and paragraph.textAlign — build the toolbar from this rather than hard-coding the values.

markable.description: Node may carry `marks`. True for every inline node, including hardBreak and image.

attrs.description: Allowed attributes, keyed by attribute name.
Allowed attributes, keyed by attribute name.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the stored envelope, not of this whitelist. Additive whitelist changes do not bump it — read `nodes`/`marks` to know what is accepted.

nodes.description: Accepted node types, keyed by type name. An unknown node is a rejected save, not a stripped one, so do not offer a control for a type absent here.

marks.description: Accepted mark types, keyed by type name.

limits.description: Structural limits: maxDepth, maxNodes, maxTextLength, maxMentions.

capabilities.description: RICH_TEXT only. The node/mark/attribute whitelist this deployment accepts, generated from the validator. A rich text editor cannot degrade gracefully — an unknown node is a rejected save, not a stripped one — so read this before offering a control rather than discovering the limit through a 400.

localizable.description: Whether the field keeps one value per organization content language.

contentSourceLanguage.description: Content language this object's base field values are written in. Null when the object is not localized. Must be one of the organization's content languages, and immutable once any field is localizable.

localizable.description: Whether the field keeps one value per organization content language. A localizable field accepts `$i18n.<locale>.<fieldKey>` on writes and resolves through `contentLocale` on reads.

contentSourceLanguage.description: Content language this object's base field values are written in. Null when the object is not localized.

operations.description: Operations enabled by this object API exposure profile.

values.description: Record values allowed by the object API exposure profile.

contentLocale.description: The content locale the values were resolved in. Present only when contentLocale was requested.

i18n.description: Stored translations keyed by content locale, then field key. Present only when includeI18n=true.

expanded.description: Expanded relation values keyed by field key.

files.description: File metadata keyed by FILE/FILES field key.

values.description: Writable custom field values for the target object. A localizable field may additionally carry translations under the reserved `$i18n` key, keyed by content locale then field key; the field itself always holds the source-language value.

entityType.description: API-supported target entity type. Supported values: `contractor` (Contractor).

publicToken.description: Opaque public lookup token. Present only for public forms.

availableTypes.description: Types the current caller can use. Present on available-form responses.

accessSources.description: Union of access sources that made this form available to the current caller.

layoutAvailability.description: Layout availability by form type. Present on dynamic-object form responses.

usableTypes.description: Form types that are currently usable because the form type is available and a published valid View Layout exists.

config.description: UI config: title, successMessage, description, resetAfterSubmit, redirectUrl

Controls who may execute a transition out of this stage. "assignee" (the default when unset) restricts it to the current assignees; "everyone" lets any user who can see the record move it on.

hiddenActions.description: Entity action keys hidden while a record is in this stage. Hidden actions are omitted from presentations and refused by their commands.

actionAccessConfig.description: Entity action keys hidden while a record is in this stage. Hidden actions are omitted from presentations and refused by their commands.

logic.description: Condition group logic. Used when conditions is present. Defaults to AND when omitted.

conditions.description: Nested condition members. When present, this node is evaluated as a group.

key.description: Stable key returned in condition evaluation results when this condition fails.

value1.description: Left operand for a leaf condition. String values may contain LiquidJS interpolation such as {{ record.snapshot.summary.status }}.

operator.description: Leaf comparison operator. Legacy workflow operators eq, neq, empty, not_empty, and present are also accepted for existing definitions.

value2.description: Right operand for a leaf condition. Not required by unary operators such as IS_EMPTY and IS_NOT_EMPTY.

reason.description: Optional user-facing explanation returned when this condition blocks transition execution.
reason.example: Amount must be present before approving.

field.description: Legacy workflow field name. Prefer value1 with LiquidJS expressions for new definitions.

parameters.description: Liquid-capable values for MANUAL rule trigger parameters. Unsupported for WORKFLOW_TRANSITIONED rules.

rules.description: Rules explicitly executed after this transition commits. Allowed triggerType values are MANUAL and WORKFLOW_TRANSITIONED.

scripts.description: Client-side transition scripts returned to FE as an ordered execution plan. These scripts are UX automation only; backend transition enforcement remains authoritative.

assignmentMode.description: Controls whether the target stage accepts exactly one assignee or multiple assignees. Defaults to single.

membershipMode.description: Controls membership candidate scope. "specific" uses membershipIds; "any" allows any membership in the organization. Defaults to "specific".

mode.description: How assignment is resolved when this transition is executed. FE should require assignee selection only for mode "select".

assignee.description: Resolved automatic assignee for fixed transition assignment or target-stage default assignment when exactly one assignee exists. Compatibility field.

assignees.description: Resolved automatic assignees for fixed transition assignment or target-stage default assignment.

candidates.description: Effective allowed choices when mode is "select", after applying the target stage assignment candidate gate. FE should send assignee for single target stages and assignees for multiple target stages.

canExecute.description: False when the transition is visible but blocked — either by the stage transitionAccessConfig (the actor is not an assignee) or by the transition conditions. Render it disabled with blockedReason rather than hiding it.

blockedReason.description: User-facing or machine-readable reason why execution is blocked.

scripts.description: Executable client-side scripts for this transition, including transitive callable CUSTOM dependencies. FE should use eventConfig.scripts as the ordered execution plan.

canTransition.description: Whether the actor may execute a transition out of the stage the record currently sits on, per that stage transitionAccessConfig. True when no workflow is running.

variables.description: Evaluated public/domain runtime variables. Internal actor and tenant variables are omitted.

layoutId.description: Diagnostic View Layout ID. Runtime access is selected and authorized through the typed owner route.

versionId.description: Published View Layout version ID. Runtime access is selected and authorized through the typed owner route.

data.description: Per-node runtime payload, keyed by node id. For a dynamic field or relation-table node, `data[nodeId].field` is a ViewLayoutDynamicFieldRuntimeDto. Required-ness is NOT there — it is a property of the layout node (`required`).

requirements.description: Optional subset of requirements from the resolved layout. When omitted, backend resolves all current layout requirements.

clientContext.description: Optional client context for lazy loaders. Backend treats this as advisory and re-resolves the authoritative layout context.

unitDictionaryEntryId.description: Dictionary entry ID selected from the catalog item units dictionary.

currencyCode.description: ISO currency code. Defaults to the organization currency.

set.description: One-to-one subordinate payload. Creates the owned row during parent create.

create.description: One-to-many subordinate rows to create during parent create.

clientMutationId.description: Required for aggregate create idempotency. Scope is organization + parent module/object + form + clientMutationId.

workflowId.description: Workflow to start immediately after creating the parent dynamic record. Required when one or more active workflows apply to the target dynamic object; omit only when no active workflow applies.

relationTables.description: Optional relation-table mutations. Omit or send an empty object for a parent-only create.

subordinateObjects.description: Nested subordinate object mutations keyed by SUBORDINATE_OBJECT_REFERENCE field key. Regular references must not use this envelope.

id.description: User id or company role id.

label.description: Current display name of the mentioned target.

active.description: False when the target no longer resolves (deactivated, deleted, or out of company). Render the frozen label from the document, inert.

displayLabel.description: Backend-resolved display label for this record, using the dynamic object displayLabel template when configured and the standard record-label fallback otherwise.

_expanded.description: Only present when ?expand was used. Keys are expandable field keys: REFERENCE, USER, USER_MULTI, CONTRACTOR, CONTRACTOR_MULTI, BUDGET, or BUDGET_MULTI. Expanded dynamic REFERENCE records include id, displayLabel, moduleKey, objectKey, objectName, color, and icon. Expanded built-in user/contractor references include id, type, displayLabel, and source-specific metadata such as email, fullName, or acronym. ONE_TO_ONE fields: value is the referenced record or null for a dangling reference. ONE_TO_MANY fields: value is an array of referenced records (null entries for dangling references). Form-gated reads may reduce ONE_TO_MANY form FIELD config.displayMode="table" values to lightweight reference summaries so custom HTML can render labels while table rows are loaded through relation-table endpoints.

_files.description: Present when the object has FILE or FILES fields with stored values. Keys are field keys. FILE values are file metadata or null for dangling references. FILES values are arrays of file metadata with null entries for dangling references.

_mentions.description: Present on detail reads when the record has RICH_TEXT fields containing mentions. Keys are field keys. Resolved at read time and not stored: join your document mention nodes by kind + id to get the current label, and fall back to the frozen label in the node when a target is missing or `active` is false. List endpoints omit this and return plainText only.

workflow.description: Workflow state for the parent record when create started a workflow.

set.description: One-to-one subordinate payload. Creates the owned row during parent create.

create.description: One-to-many subordinate rows to create during parent create.

remove.description: One-to-one subordinate removal. Cannot be combined with set.

update.description: One-to-many subordinate rows to update. Each row must already be owned by this parent field.

removeIds.description: One-to-many subordinate row IDs to remove. Each row must already be owned by this parent field.

clientMutationId.description: Recommended for every aggregate update. Required when child rows are created or deleted.

expectedValues.description: Optimistic concurrency. Values the client believes the record currently holds, keyed by field key. When any of them has changed the update is rejected with 409 RECORD_VALUE_CONFLICT so the client can reload instead of clobbering someone else’s change. Only the named keys are checked; omit for last-write-wins.

clear.description: Field keys to clear. Multi-value fields become empty and other fields become null. A key must be editable on the form, must not be required, and must not also appear in values. A null inside values is still ignored.

subordinateObjects.description: Nested subordinate object mutations keyed by SUBORDINATE_OBJECT_REFERENCE field key. Regular references must not use this envelope.

resolvedOptions.description: Server-resolved option rows for a SELECT/MULTI_SELECT whose `options` name a saved query — the client cannot execute one itself. Absent for static, dictionary-backed, and non-select fields, which the client resolves from `options`.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in WGS84 degrees.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in WGS84 degrees.

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometres. Matches points whose great-circle distance from the centre is at most this.

value.description: Condition value. For `in`/`notIn` provide an array. For `between` provide a 2-item array. Omit for `isNull`/`isNotNull`. For `near` (geo point fields only) provide `{ lat, lng, radiusKm }` — the only object value.

items.description: Recursive filter tree. Each item is either a nested group or a condition object with `field` and `operator`.

dictionaryMetadataKey.description: For a single-valued dictionary-backed field, order by this declared dictionary entry metadata key instead of the stored entry key. The field determines the dictionary; clients never send dictionaryId.

filters.description: Recursive filter tree. V1 supports row fields only; expanded-field filters are not supported.

sort.description: Ordered sort rules. V1 supports row fields only; expanded-field sort is not supported.

search.description: Search across searchable row fields on the target object. Expanded-field search is not supported in v1.

resultSchema.description: Expected column names and types inferred from the SQL.

SavedQueryExecutionMode.description: COMPANY uses the active company. ORGANIZATION_REPORTING runs across all companies in the active organization and requires reporting permission.

executionMode.description: COMPANY uses the active company. ORGANIZATION_REPORTING runs across all companies in the active organization and requires reporting permission.

value.description: Value — pass null to clear the field. MULTI_SELECT, FILES, USER_MULTI, CONTRACTOR_MULTI, and CUSTOM_OBJECT_MULTI expect string arrays. FILE, USER, CONTRACTOR, and CUSTOM_OBJECT expect ID strings. CUSTOM_HTML expects { html, css? }; html/css support {{ path | filter }} templates. Custom HTML blocks that are layout-only belong in View Layouts. SIGNATURE expects { fileId, signedAt?, signedByName?, signedByUserId? }; upload the PNG first and pass the returned file id. COLOR expects a hex colour such as #3DBBFD; #RGB shorthand is expanded and the value is stored uppercased, alpha is rejected, and null is the only way to clear it. GEO_POINT expects { lat, lng, source, accuracyM?, placeId?, provider?, expiresAt? }; capturedAt is stamped by the server. RICH_TEXT expects { doc } — a Tiptap/ProseMirror document. format, schemaVersion, plainText, referencedFileIds, and mentionRefs are derived server-side and rejected if sent. Images carry a fileId from a rich-text upload route, never a URL.

doc.description: Dokument ProseMirror/Tiptap. Jedyny element przesyłany przez klienta. Węzły, znaczniki i atrybuty są objęte listą dozwolonych: nieznane są odrzucane błędem 400 ze wskazaniem ścieżki, a nie usuwane po cichu. Przed udostępnieniem kontrolki edytora odczytaj `capabilities` we wpisie katalogu typów pól RICH_TEXT, aby poznać dokładny akceptowany zestaw. Obrazy wskazują fileId z trasy przesyłania obrazów tekstu sformatowanego, nigdy adres URL.

oneOf.description: Punkt geograficzny. Zapisuj { lat, lng, source, accuracyM?, placeId?, provider?, expiresAt? }; null czyści wartość. lat/lng to stopnie WGS84 zaokrąglane do 7 miejsc po przecinku. source to jedna z wartości USER_PIN, DEVICE, GEOCODED, IMPORTED. capturedAt jest ustawiane przez serwer przy każdej zmianie punktu (przesłana wartość jest ignorowana). expiresAt jest wymagane dla GEOCODED, przycinane do najwyżej 30 dni naprzód, i odrzucane dla innych źródeł. Po upływie expiresAt wartość jest odczytywana jako { placeId?, provider?, source, expiresAt, expired: true } bez współrzędnych. Zapisy przez zewnętrzne API i MCP są zapisywane jako IMPORTED, a ich expiresAt jest pomijane.

validationConfig.description: Type-specific validation config. VAT_ID includes format, UX verification, and result mapping metadata. FILE displayMode may be "any" or "image"; FILES displayMode may be "any" or "gallery". SELECT/MULTI_SELECT static option lists live at validationConfig.options and use the CustomFieldSelectOptionDto shape: { value, label, color?, icon? }. color is uppercase #RRGGBB (#RGB is expanded on write, alpha rejected); icon is an opaque client token. Dictionary-backed fields carry neither here — their colour and icon come from the dictionary entry. SQL-backed option sources support neither.

position.description: Derived display order of this step in the rule graph (stable; not execution semantics).

branchKey.description: Edge branch key: default, or true/false for CONDITION.

edges.description: Directed edges of the rule graph.

loopStepId.description: Id of the LOOP step whose frame was active.

item.description: The item this iteration is bound to (context.loop.item). Present on the LOOP step's own 'each' entry, not on body entries. May be a { __truncated: true, kind, size } marker.

count.description: Total iterations this frame will run. Present alongside item on the LOOP step's 'each' entry.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code when one was supplied.

message.description: Failure message, truncated to 500 characters. Never a stack.

seq.description: Position in the run, 0-based and monotonic. Entries are already in visit order.

stepType.description: Step type as it was when the visit happened.

stepName.description: Step name as it was when the visit happened.

status.description: How the visit ended. 'caught' means the step threw and its error edge continued the run; 'failed' means the throw (or a failed STOP) ended it.

branchTaken.description: Port the visit left by: 'default', 'true'/'false', a SWITCH case id, 'otherwise', 'each'/'done', or 'error'. Null when the run ended here.

contextKey.description: Context key this step publishes under, if any.

output.description: The value published under contextKey by this visit — the context delta. Absent when the step published nothing. An oversized value is replaced by { __truncated: true, kind, size }.

loop.description: Set for visits inside a LOOP body, naming the iteration.

captured.description: True when a dry run captured this step instead of performing it, so output is the capture marker.

truncated.description: True when the run visited more nodes than entries holds.

totalVisits.description: Nodes visited by the run, counted past the entry cap.

contextSnapshot.description: Redacted diagnostic context, bounded to 256 KiB. __diagnosticIncomplete marks redacted or truncated snapshots, which cannot be used as replay inputs.

steps.description: Bounded, redacted per-visit history (at most 200 entries and 512 KiB); outputs can be truncation markers. Fold entries[0..k] over contextSnapshot.trigger/organization — assigning entry.output to entry.contextKey whenever output is present — to reproduce the state at step k. Returned by the execution detail endpoint only; absent on executions recorded before the journal existed.

authorUserId.description: User ID to store as the mutable workflow Author/Reporter, or null to clear the author. Non-null users must be members of the active organization.

assignee.description: Selected assignee for transitions configured with assignment mode "select". Use for target stages with assignmentMode "single" or as a one-item compatibility shorthand.

assignees.description: Selected assignees for transitions configured with assignment mode "select" when the target stage assignmentMode is "multiple". Must be non-empty when provided.

moduleKey.description: Dynamic module key for DYNAMIC_OBJECT_RECORD targets.

objectKey.description: Dynamic object key for DYNAMIC_OBJECT_RECORD targets.

assignee.description: Next task assignee for single-assignee stages, or a one-item compatibility shorthand. Null is invalid.

assignees.description: Replacement assignee set for the shared workflow task. Must be non-empty when provided. Null and empty arrays are invalid.

signatureText.description: Account signature as it was when this draft was created. Already part of `bodyText`; present here so a composer can show it below the editable body instead of pulling it into the editor.

quotedText.description: The quoted original, snapshotted when the reply or forward was created. Unaffected by later edits or deletion of the source message.

quoteOriginal.description: Whether the quote is currently part of the delivered body. Toggle it through the draft update endpoint.

compositionContext.description: Everything appended to the body on the way out: the signature and quote snapshots, and whether the quote is switched on. Present for every draft Opero composed, and absent on inbound mail. Render it as read-only context and do not send it back — the server re-applies it on every write, so a copy inside your body would be delivered twice.
